g.text: Initialising all six sub-systems of the Cross-OS Runtime Layer
runtime-core — scheduler · memory manager · resource abstractor
compatibility-modules — Windows · Linux · Android · Legacy Mobile
system-call-translator — OS syscall → Linux kernel call
app-manager — install · launch · suspend · resume · kill
